# `http` standard library

`#use http` provides an outbound HTTP/1.1 client with keep-alive connection
pooling, `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` decoding, transparent `https://` support,
Server-Sent Events (SSE) formatting and parsing, and RFC 6455 WebSocket
handshake, frame encoding/decoding, and client sockets.

```{.dva .run}
#use http
#use io
#use str

raw = "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n7\r\n{\"ok\":1\r\n1\r\n}\r\n0\r\n\r\n"
res = http::parse_response(raw)!!
io::out $ str::from_int(res.status) + " " + res.body

evts = http::SseEvents()
evts += http::sse_event_id("1", "tick", "hello\nworld")
parsed = http::sse_parse(http::sse_encode_events(evts))
first = parsed(0)!!
io::out $ first.event + ":" + first.data
```

## Request and Response Types

- `Header`: `(name: String, value: String)`
- `Headers`: `Header{}`
- `Request`: `(method: String, url: String, headers: Headers, body: String, timeout_ms: Int)`
- `Response`: `(status: Int, reason: String, headers: Headers, body: String)`
- `Client`: `(pool: PoolEntries, default_headers: Headers, timeout_ms: Int)`

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `headers` | `() => Headers` | Creates an empty `Headers` collection. |
| `add_header` | `Headers, String, String => Headers` | Appends a `Header` to `Headers`. |
| `get_header` | `Headers, String => < String | >` | Case-insensitive header lookup. |
| `has_header` | `Headers, String => <>` | True when a header is present (case-insensitive). |
| `request_new` | `String, String => Request` | Creates a request with method and URL (`timeout_ms = 10000`). |
| `with_header` | `Request, String, String => Request` | Appends a request header. |
| `with_headers` | `Request, Headers => Request` | Merges multiple headers into a request. |
| `with_body` | `Request, String => Request` | Sets the request body. |
| `with_json_body` | `Request, String => Request` | Sets `Content-Type: application/json` and JSON payload. |
| `with_bearer` | `Request, String => Request` | Sets `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. |
| `with_timeout` | `Request, Int => Request` | Sets timeout in milliseconds. |
| `response_header` | `Response, String => < String | >` | Case-insensitive response header lookup. |
| `response_json` | `Response => < json::Value | Error >` | Parses `res.body` as a `json::Value`. |
| `response_ccl` | `Response => < ccl::CclDoc | Error >` | Parses `res.body` as a `ccl::CclDoc`. |
| `decode_chunked` | `String => < String | String >` | Decodes an HTTP/1.1 `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` body. |
| `parse_response` | `String => < Response | String >` | Parses a raw HTTP/1.x wire response. |

## Client and One-Shot Requests

`http://` requests use native `std/net` TCP sockets with connection pooling in
`Client`. `https://` URLs transparently delegate to `curl` via `std/os`.

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `client_new` | `() => Client` | Creates a keep-alive HTTP client pool. |
| `client_with_header` | `Client, String, String => Client` | Adds a default header sent on every request. |
| `client_send` | `Client, Request => < Response | String >` | Sends a `Request` using the client's connection pool. |
| `client_close` | `Client => ()` | Closes all pooled keep-alive sockets. |
| `send` | `Request => < Response | String >` | Sends a one-shot `Request`. |
| `get` | `String => < Response | String >` | Performs `GET <url>`. |
| `get_with_headers` | `String, Headers => < Response | String >` | Performs `GET <url>` with custom headers. |
| `post` | `String, String, String => < Response | String >` | Performs `POST <url>` with content-type and body. |
| `post_json` | `String, String => < Response | String >` | Performs `POST <url>` with a JSON string body. |
| `post_json_val` | `#! T: Type, String, T => < Response | String >` | Serializes `val` via `json::encode` and performs `POST <url>`. |
| `put_json` | `String, String => < Response | String >` | Performs `PUT <url>` with a JSON string body. |
| `patch_json` | `String, String => < Response | String >` | Performs `PATCH <url>` with a JSON string body. |
| `delete` | `String => < Response | String >` | Performs `DELETE <url>`. |

## Server-Sent Events (SSE)

- `SseEvent`: `(id: String, event: String, data: String, retry_ms: Int)`
- `SseEvents`: `SseEvent{}`

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sse_data` | `String => SseEvent` | Creates an unnamed SSE event with `data`. |
| `sse_event` | `String, String => SseEvent` | Creates an SSE event with `event` name and `data`. |
| `sse_event_id` | `String, String, String => SseEvent` | Creates an SSE event with `id`, `event`, and `data`. |
| `sse_encode` | `SseEvent => String` | Formats a single SSE event block (`text/event-stream`). |
| `sse_encode_events` | `SseEvents => String` | Formats a sequence of SSE events. |
| `sse_parse` | `String => SseEvents` | Parses a `text/event-stream` payload into `SseEvents`. |

## RFC 6455 WebSocket Client and Framing

- `WsFrame`: `(opcode: Int, fin: <>, payload: String, consumed: Int)`
- `WsConn`: `(fd: Int, leftover: String)`
- Opcode constants: `WS_OP_CONT` (`0`), `WS_OP_TEXT` (`1`), `WS_OP_BINARY` (`2`), `WS_OP_CLOSE` (`8`), `WS_OP_PING` (`9`), `WS_OP_PONG` (`10`)

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ws_accept_key` | `String => String` | Computes RFC 6455 `Sec-WebSocket-Accept` from `Sec-WebSocket-Key`. |
| `ws_encode_frame` | `Int, String, <> => String` | Encodes a WebSocket frame (`masked = <+>` for client-to-server). |
| `ws_decode_frame` | `String => < WsFrame | >` | Decodes the next frame from a wire buffer. |
| `ws_connect` | `String => < WsConn | String >` | Connects and performs RFC 6455 upgrade handshake for `ws://host:port/path`. |
| `ws_send_text` | `WsConn, String => <>` | Sends a masked `WS_OP_TEXT` frame. |
| `ws_send_binary` | `WsConn, String => <>` | Sends a masked `WS_OP_BINARY` frame. |
| `ws_recv` | `WsConn => < WsFrame | String >` | Receives the next WebSocket frame. |
| `ws_close` | `WsConn => ()` | Sends `WS_OP_CLOSE` and closes the socket. |
